title: Twisting abelian tower transitions by a fixed integer
statement: Let C be a preadditive category and l a natural number. The power-transition functor V_l on towers X in C leaves X_n unchanged and replaces each successive transition t_n by l times t_n. It leaves every component of every morphism unchanged. There is a natural transformation mu_l:V_l → Id with component at level n equal to l^(n+1) times the identity. The functor is additive. If C is abelian it preserves quasi-isomorphisms of cochain complexes of towers.

source.place: Functorial derived completion: simultaneous tensor with quotient rings; resolution [Z --ell^n--> Z] with transitions (ell,1). For the ordinary quotient see Stacks sites-modules.tex, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict (03D7); for resolutions see sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-K-flat-resolution (06YS) and lemma-derived-base-change (06YY).

proof.text: Construct the tower and every morphism by Functor.ofOpSequence and NatTrans.ofOpSequence. The compatibility square is l times the old naturality square. The powers satisfy l times l^(n+1)=l^(n+2), giving multiplication. Functoriality and additivity are componentwise.
After exact evaluation at any level the twisted cochain map is literally the original evaluated cochain map. HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_iff_evaluation proves preservation of quasi-isomorphisms.
